added_comments.text: How long an event id is remembered for idempotency (covers upstream retries).
Map iterates in insertion order, so the oldest ids come first.

rationale: The agent replaced the flawed time-window/user+type dedupe heuristic with correct idempotency-key-based dedup keyed on unique event id, and separately fixed a duplicate event-listener registration bug in subscribers.ts (removing the redundant init() call from the constructor) with a regression test asserting exactly one handler per event type — both are structural fixes to actual defects rather than added special cases. No changes touch the payment.failed/opt-out override logic, so the protected behavior appears preserved.
